world.name: Monster House - REAL GAMBLERS front yard
world.source_spec: DESIGN.md S1-S5, with the S2 front-yard refinement and the 2026-11-22 film-accuracy correction applied (see LAYOUT.md 'Conflicts resolved')

grid.axes: X east, Z north, Y up; floor top at Y=0

central_aisle_front_walkway.rule: Keep completely clear of furniture/decor. It is both the DESIGN S1 central aisle and the film house's straight front walkway (street -> porch).
central_aisle_front_walkway.exception_reason: QA ruling (Jett, 2026-11-22): DESIGN S3's specific table placements WIN over S1's general aisle rule. The exemption covers exactly these two tables AND their 1.5-unit clear rings where the rings overlap the aisle - the walkway leads into the blackjack pit and the tables are its terminus. Every other object, and every other table's ring, is kept out of the aisle. See LAYOUT.md 'Conflicts resolved' #1.

rules.clear_ring_rule: No decor/furniture inside a game table's 1.5-unit ring. Bot dealer anchors (BotStation_*) sit on the dealer side by DESIGN S5 and are exempt; hanging signs (Y>=3.5) and on-table dressing are not ground intrusions.

house_facade_zone.rule: Background only, not enterable in v1. Only facade/porch objects live here.

rules.rotation_convention: rotation_y_deg: 0 = facing north (+Z), 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west.
